topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I walked into the café, the usual place where our worlds collided, but today, the air felt different, heavier. I saw her, my best friend, fingering the rim of her coffee cup, the same one with the little crack on the side we always joke about. She started talking, and the words, they hung in the air, thick and leaden. Across the country, she said. My hands found their way to the cold surface of the table. I nodded, trying to smile, but the corners of my mouth wouldn’t lift. The café seemed to shrink, the walls closing in, and I could hear the steady beat of the rain against the window, the rhythm of something changing, something shifting beyond our control.
